scope: Local production-build regression using disposable PostgreSQL and synthetic fixtures; not production deployment or full release acceptance.

environment.database: New dedicated loopback-only disposable E2E database; credentials loaded privately.

regression.command: pnpm --filter @valkyria/web exec playwright test e2e/switch-query-hydration.spec.ts --project chromium --workers 1 '--reporter=list,json'
observed: Baseline JavaScript-disabled SSR exposes actionable game and locale anchors without view=results; both tests fail the aria-disabled assertion.
Candidate pending choices have no href, aria-disabled=true, native tabIndex=-1 and an aria-busy group; current choices remain marked.
Normal-browser game and locale navigation both retain view=results and assert the active Results filter after arrival.

neighbors.command: pnpm --filter @valkyria/web exec playwright test e2e/platform.spec.ts e2e/shell.spec.ts --project chromium --workers 1 --grep 'game switch keeps|language switch keeps|language switcher links|article provenance and language' '--reporter=list,json'

dirtyFormGuard.command: pnpm --filter @valkyria/web exec playwright test e2e/admin-editorial-safety.spec.ts --project chromium-admin --no-deps --workers 1 --grep 'unsaved changes are guarded' '--reporter=list,json'

captures.test: game choice cannot discard a results filter while its destination is loading
captures.caption: Game switch from Czech Wardogs results retains the selected Results filter in Czech HLL; synthetic match fixture.

captures.test: language choice cannot discard a results filter while its destination is loading
captures.caption: Language switch from English HLL results retains the selected Results filter in Czech HLL; synthetic match fixture.

limitations: These bounded local tests are not the complete required CI, protected publication or live acceptance.
Both builds used environment-default settings fallback while building; runtime used a freshly reset, owned synthetic E2E database.
Initial unquoted PowerShell reporter argument failed before any tests; retained privately as invocation-error.log.

The earlier external-script gate attempt was investigative: inline streamed reveal can proceed without external scripts. Its separate red report is retained; final acceptance uses the identical JavaScript-disabled-context spec on both builds.
Neighbor server output includes three destination-stream-closed-early messages. Those tests have no comprehensive network gate; this result does not resolve issue46 or waive network failures.
Raw local reports contain machine paths and remain private; this compact record preserves their byte fingerprints.
